title: HB 4765 (2025-2026 Regular Session, Michigan Legislature (bill page title: "House Bill 4765 of 2025")): Elections: registration; proof of United States citizenship when registering to vote and identification when voting; require. Amends secs. 493a, 493b, 495, 509gg & 509ii of 1954 PA 116 (MCL 168.493a et seq.) & adds sec. 496c.

(d_proof_of_citizenship)
(section) Sec. 15a (as in the version read)
(quote) "Federal-only voter" means a voter registration applicant whose United States citizenship has not been verified, who is not a registered elector under this act, and who is not entitled to vote in any election other than an election for federal offices.
(section) Sec. 496c (as in the version read)
(quote) (1) After a voter registration applicant applies to register to vote, the secretary of state shall verify the applicant's citizenship status by using existing databases maintained by the department of state and the United States Department of Homeland Security and by using any other reliable sources.
(section) Sec. 496c (as in the version read)
(quote) (2) A voter registration applicant may provide satisfactory evidence of United States citizenship to expedite the verification of citizenship status by presenting 1 of the documents listed in this section in person, or by including a photocopy of 1 of the documents listed in this section with the applicant's mailed voter registration application.
(section) Sec. 496c (as in the version read)
(quote) Satisfactory evidence of United States citizenship includes any of the following documents:
(section) Sec. 496c (as in the version read)
(quote) (a) The applicant's driver license or personal identification card issued by the department of state or the equivalent department of another state if that department indicates on the applicant's driver license or personal identification card that the individual has provided satisfactory evidence of United States citizenship.
(section) Sec. 496c (as in the version read)
(quote) (b) The applicant's birth certificate that verifies United States citizenship.
(section) Sec. 496c (as in the version read)
(quote) The applicant's birth certificate may be accompanied by a marriage license or other documentation that shows a name change.
(section) Sec. 496c (as in the version read)
(quote) (c) The pertinent pages of the applicant's United States passport identifying the applicant and the applicant's passport number.
(section) Sec. 496c (as in the version read)
(quote) (d) The applicant's United States naturalization documents or number of the Certificate of Naturalization.
(section) Sec. 496c (as in the version read)
(quote) (e) The applicant's Certificate of Citizenship.
(section) Sec. 496c (as in the version read)
(quote) (f) An American Indian Card issued by the United States Department of Homeland Security with the classification "KIC".
(section) Sec. 496c (as in the version read)
(quote) (a) The secretary of state shall notify the applicant that the applicant's citizenship status could not be verified and the applicant must be given an opportunity to provide satisfactory evidence of United States citizenship to the secretary of state.
(section) Sec. 496c (as in the version read)
(quote) (c) The applicant is designated as a federal-only voter in the qualified voter file and is eligible to vote only in elections for federal offices, and is not eligible to vote in state or local elections until the applicant provides satisfactory evidence of United States citizenship to the secretary of state.
(section) Sec. 496c (as in the version read)
(quote) (4) If the secretary of state receives satisfactory evidence of United States citizenship from a voter registration applicant described under subsection (3), the secretary of state shall immediately register the applicant as a registered elector under this act and remove the federal-only voter designation in the qualified voter file, and that registered elector is eligible to vote in all elections.
(section) Sec. 495 (as in the version read)
(quote) (ii) The secretary of state shall verify the citizenship status of the applicant.
(section) Sec. 495 (as in the version read)
(quote) (iii) The applicant may expedite the verification of citizenship status by providing to the secretary of state satisfactory evidence of United States citizenship.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Sec. 509ii (as in the version read)
(quote) (e) Provide an option that allows an applicant to upload satisfactory evidence of United States citizenship for the citizenship verification by the secretary of state as provided under section 496c.
(section) Sec. 509ii (as in the version read)
(quote) The option must clearly indicate to the applicant that uploading satisfactory evidence of United States citizenship on the electronic voter registration interface is not a condition for registering to vote.
(section) Sec. 509ii (as in the version read)
(quote) (a) The identification number for the applicant on any of the following:
(section) Sec. 509ii (as in the version read)
(quote) (b) If the applicant does not have an identification number for an identification as provided under subdivision (a), the last 4 digits of a valid Social Security number for the applicant.
